items.title: MECH-449 endogenous safety-veto producer validation (running-scale calibrated, harm-ON vs harm-OFF control, ground-truth specificity)
items.note: Substrate validation (diagnostic, non_contributory) for the default-OFF MECH-449 endogenous safety producer (E3Config.use_gng_endogenous_safety; chip-20260918-mech449-endogenous-safety-veto-producer). A PASS satisfies EVB-1409/EXP-0796 (MECH-049) release_condition (b) ONLY; resetting that proposal is /governance's call. CALIBRATION PROVENANCE: orchestrator decisions (orchestrate-20260924-0808, .scratch/orch-20260924/QUESTIONS.md) DECIDED Q-MECH449 -> A (per-seed running harm scale, z-score vs EMA, veto at > +2 SD; three specificity checks; per-seed harm_range >= 0.02 precondition) and Q-MECH449-FLOOR -> A (sd floor = 0.02 / 2 = 0.01, derived; an untrained head is NOT flat in candidate space -- dry-run running raw sd ~0.005-0.007 -- so 0.005 would not bind). Numeric operationalisations confirmed by the orchestrator: C2 fire rate <= 0.25; C4 harm-off fire rate <= 0.01 on every control seed; C3 ground-truth (counterfactual one-step env deepcopy per distinct first action) vetoed-minus-non-vetoed hazard proximity > 0 with >= 5 mixed ticks; C1-C3 each on >= ceil(2/3 n_ok) precondition-met ON seeds; >= 3/5 ON seeds must meet the precondition else substrate_not_ready_requeue. PREMISE CORRECTION: the chip's 'harm pathway already discriminative' held on 1/3 seeds in the 603k regime; this run trains on the 603q ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY regime (V3-EXQ-866b re-run 2026-08-03: 3/3 seeds, harm_eval_range 0.115-0.470), with 5 ON seeds. Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (endogenous n_safety_nogo_applied) cannot exist in any prior manifest -- the producer did not exist -> run. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: MECH-449 count 1 (937b) < 2. Step 2.5c: SD-PP-B5 (corrupting) overlaps only via ree_core/utils/config.py; its defect is confined to opt-in use_world_interventional, which this driver does not set -- dismissed. Degrading overlaps on agent.py::select_action noted: SD-091, mech005-betagate-decommit-counter, mech290-committed-trajectory-one-way-gate, suffering-derivative-comparator-refractory (603q base enables use_suffering_derivative_comparator, as 603q/866b did), SD-MECH267-CEM-SELECTION-FIX. DV-SYMMETRY: ON arm -- running-scale threshold count + within-tick paired ground-truth difference; not invariant to the manipulation (a uniform per-tick offset can move the count, which is why C2 bounds the rate and C3 is within-tick paired). OFF arm -- same DVs, tests the floor's specificity; would_fire_without_sd_floor recorded. Gate armed only in the 10-episode eval: use_go_nogo_constitution + use_f_eligibility_demotion with the channel-adaptive mean-relative floor. red-team (fable): CONTESTED -- F1 fixed (absolute 0.30 envelope floor all-admitted K=32 -> F-blind eval; now adaptive floor, dry run envelope ~16/32, never all-admit); F2 partly fixed (predicted-state headroom diagnostics recorded; does_not_fire label defers to them) and partly dismissed (precondition is over real states, veto excursion over predicted states that drift more -- not equal by construction); F3 dismissed (pre-registered + orchestrator-confirmed; frac_positive recorded); F4 fixed (unscored control / never-armed gate -> substrate_not_ready_requeue). Smoke PASS (dry run, armed branch + counterfactual exercised). Run on cloud (multinomial selection).

items.title: MECH-266/SD-032a: squash-vs-clamp affinity bounding-operator cap sweep with gain-matched control arm (diagnostic)
items.note: Validates mode-governance-engagement ITEM (1) (the affinity bounding operator) ONLY; items (2) commitment-term grading and (3) production default remain OPEN and are untouched. DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from confidence scoring). PROMOTES NOTHING -- MECH-266 / SD-032a pending_retest_after_substrate holds, and the Stage-H nav-competence dependency gating v3_exq_464d/467d is untouched. DESIGN: crosses the affinity bounding OPERATOR with the cap at EVAL time on clones of one trained curriculum agent per seed (cap, mode and sigma all read live at SalienceCoordinator.tick()). THREE bound arms x CAP_SWEEP [0.75,1.0,1.25,1.5,1.75] x 2 rail arms x 3 seeds [42,43,44] = 30 cells/seed: clamp_baseline (w=3.0, the V3-EXQ-934 baseline design), squash (sigma=cap default), and clamp_gain_matched (clamp operator, w'(cap)=3.0*(cap/(cap+1))/min(1,cap)) -- the ATTRIBUTION CONTROL added by USER DECISION 2026-09-19T23:52:40Z OPTION A. Training held at cap 2.0 under the clamp (464e/934 construction). Seeds 42-44 kept deliberately (934's; its seed 44 guard-PASSED with the highest contact rate, 0.3064). LOAD-BEARING DV: occupancy -- the squash arm's ARM_SYMMETRIC gate via experiments/_lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py, GRADED iff >=2 CONSECUTIVE cap values each mixed in (0.1,0.9) on >=2/3 seeds. Bar TRANSCRIBED from the entry's own failure_record target, never re-derived; gate called ONCE per (bound_arm, rail_arm) over ALL (seed,cap) cells with seed AND sweep_value populated -- NOT 934's per-seed call shape, which is what produced its false routing. The continuous margin is RECORDED AS TELEMETRY WITH NO THRESHOLD (user decision): no numeric threshold for the squash-vs-clamp contrast is registered anywhere. WHY THE THIRD ARM: red-team pass 1 (fable) returned BLOCKING, verified against source -- the operator is applied to EVERY affinity_weights signal (salience_coordinator.py:616-636) including the [0,1]-bounded external_task_drive (agent.py:2760-2765, w=3.0), and at sigma=cap the squash returns 0.500x AT the cap, so clamp->squash moved the external_task logit by -0.96..-1.50 while the dacc_pe degeneracy fix under test moved its logit by only -0.034..-0.173 (8x-28x confound). With two arms neither a PASS nor the null was attributable. GFLAG-0370 records this and also that the why_sigma_equals_cap rationale in the substrate entry does not hold as written. RED-TEAM pass 1 (fable): BLOCKING -> resolved by user OPTION A. RED-TEAM pass 2 (fable, licensed re-spawn since the manipulation changed): CONTESTED, 4 findings, ALL reproduced against source and FIXED -- (F1) the (squash NOT graded, gain_matched graded) cell was unrouted and recorded a false 'no_arm_graded' reason with SD-032a weakens, now its own branch -> gain/non_contributory; (F2) the gain match holds only at engagement e=1.0, so 'the control did not grade' could be over-cutting rather than gradedness -- a false-positive path to supports; cells now record REALIZED drive contribution under all three arm definitions and the gradedness attribution is gated on gain_match_valid (residual < the gain cut it reproduces; boundary definitional, not tuned); (F3) 'occupancy static across arms' was attributed to the item-(2) latch unconditionally, now requires et_sat_mean>0 since engagement near zero produces the same reading; (F4) INHERITED FROM V3-EXQ-934 -- the external_task_drive_engages precondition cannot see a dead drive: measured, with the drive signal at EXACTLY 0.0 the margin still reads 0.3287-0.4950, 6.6x-9.9x the 0.05 floor, because it is floored by external_task_bias=1.0; added external_task_drive_signal_nonzero (a zero-test on the drive's own value). F4 is worth governance attention on its own account. PAIRING: cells are RNG- AND ENV-paired across bound arms (per-cell seed derives from (seed,cap,rail_arm) only, driving reset_all_rng and a fresh per-cell env), bound arm nested INNERMOST -- fixes the vacuous 1e-6 non-degeneracy guard (banked 934 cells differing only in rails already differed by 1.7e-3) and the shared-stateful-env order confound. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = per-cap occupancy under salience_affinity_bound_mode='squash'; that mode landed 2026-09-19 and NO recorded manifest has ever set it (934/935/935a are all clamp-only), so the readout is absent from every banked run -> must run, not reanalyzable. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-266/SD-032a count=7 but RELEASED -- the named upstream substrate (mode-governance-engagement item (1), cingulate.salience_coordinator.affinity_bound_operator) shows IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-19 in ree-v3/CLAUDE.md; and this is a new EXQ number testing a different mechanism (the operator family) as a diagnostic discriminating WHY the ceiling holds, which Step 2.5b exempts independently. STEP 2.5c: no open 'corrupting' substrate_queue entry overlaps this driver's modules (mode-governance-engagement itself is severity=cosmetic). Runs under these open 'degrading' entries, recorded as known limitations: SD-018 and SD-106 (agent.py::compute_resource_proximity_loss, latent/stack.py), sd061-resume-progress-ecology (causal_grid_world.py::CausalGridWorldV2.step), SD-091 (agent.py::REEAgent.select_action), SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (config.py, causal_grid_world.py, agent.py), SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY (agent.py::REEAgent.sense). SMOKE: PASS (rc=0) -- 12 cells (3 arms x 2 caps x 2 rails), denominator ep N/45, 1 verdict line, gain-matched weights exact (1.714286 at cap 0.75, 1.5 at cap 1.0); a guard-passing run exercised the full analysis path and landed on the new F3 branch (et_drive_mean=0.7256, et_sat=0.0 -> static_but_latch_not_implicated, non_contributory), which pre-fix would have recorded SD-032a weakens against a latch that never fired. validate_experiments --strict: 38/38 OK. Successor to V3-EXQ-934; NOT a supersede -- 934 measured the clamp across the same band and that reading stands.

items.title: SD-032b candidate effort proxy validation: harm_a_forward effort spread + E3 argmin responsiveness to f_sat/cost (within-tick counterfactuals, dacc_weight 0.5)

One trained agent per seed; every contrast is a WITHIN-TICK COUNTERFACTUAL on a pre-call deep-copy snapshot: 7 forced f_sat x costs {0.1,1,10}, horizon negative control, guaranteed-flip positive control, unpatched-copy fidelity. PASS iff C1 (effort spread live) AND C2 (argmin responsive to f_sat/cost) -- the failure_record target; C2 non-degenerate only if the real manipulation's reach exceeds the top-2 gap on some ticks (else label effort_proxy_live_c2_unreachable). INERT risk measured and carried as the reach-vs-gap non-degeneracy gate. dacc_weight=0.5 NOT 1.0: at 1.0 the dACC payoff self-feedback makes e3.last_scores an undamped integrator (|last_scores| 2553->23404 over 1500 steps) -- registered as substrate_queue sd032b-payoff-self-feedback-integrator; evidence question GFLAG-0507. red-team (fable) pass 1: BLOCKING -- (1) payoff integrator at dacc_weight 1.0 -> FIXED (0.5 + boundedness precondition); (2) episode-start dACC ticks excluded from C2 -> FIXED (counterfactuals on step 0 too); (3) positive control sized to the gap cannot certify C2 reachability -> FIXED (reach-vs-gap non-degeneracy); (4) float32 quantization at |scores|~1e4 / exact 0.0 negative-control gate -> FIXED (bounded scores; 0.02 rounding tolerance); (5) C1 passes on an untrained E2_harm_a -> DISMISSED, already framed as liveness-not-validity. red-team (fable) pass 2 (one re-spawn, causal chain changed): BLOCKING -- (1) scored counterfactuals copied the POST-call agent (early-return on step-0 ticks; advanced pe/payoff state) while fidelity certified a PRE-call copy -> FIXED (one pre-call snapshot, all counterfactuals from it; fidelity now certifies the same state); (2) manipulation large only on the dropped step-0 ticks -> FIXED by (1), C2/reach also reported per tick class; (3) tautological gates (no-cf count, pe>1e-6) and n-floor on the wrong denominator -> FIXED (C1-C2 denominator-equality gate, n-floor on C2's own denominator; P2 10->60 eps since P2 episodes end by health depletion in 3-10 steps); (4) degenerate C2 labelled as a calibration null -> FIXED (label effort_proxy_live_c2_unreachable, top-level non_degenerate includes C2); (5) positive-control gain used the copy's pe -> FIXED by (1). Smoke PASS (dry-run: fidelity 3/3, neg 0, pos 3/3, C1/C2 denominators equal). Ethics preflight: all false, allow.

items.title: Contamination-footgun truncation extension probe: INV-054 (278/435), MECH-427 (883), MECH-106 (231a) x STOCK/OPTOUT, with insensitive-by-construction class and action-diversity readout
items.note: Diagnostic, claim-free (claim_ids []; audited_claim_ids INV-054, MECH-106, MECH-427 -- the three claims V3-EXQ-1080's confirmed autopsy explicitly did NOT cover). Chip chip-20260924-contamination-extension-probe, spawned by governance-20260924 once it ratified failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1080_2026-09-24 section 7. Re-runs the OWN loops of V3-EXQ-278 + 435 (INV-054), 883 (MECH-427) and 231a (MECH-106) at original full scale, twice each: ARM_STOCK as written vs ARM_OPTOUT with hazard_free_contamination_gate=True forced through a class-level CausalGridWorld wrap (binds only num_hazards==0 envs, verified at runtime: hf stock 0.5 / hf gated 0.0 / 3-hazard gated 0.5). (u) UNCERTAINTY: for these three claims, how often does the SD-094 contamination footgun actually fire in the window carrying each claim's DV, and does gating it change that run's OWN verdict? (h) H1: a target's verdict tuple differs between arms -> its prior evidence was contamination-confounded and the claim is owed a re-adjudication. H2: verdicts identical across arms despite material exposure -> the prior verdict stands as genuine evidence, within the stated per-target caveats. (s) STOP RESULT: zero verdict-sensitive determinable targets closes the contamination-hygiene question for the claims those targets can clear, and their prior dispositions stand un-revised. (n) NATIVE CONSUMER: the re-measured DV is each target's own pre-registered pass/fail criterion (recovery latency / sustained onset for INV-054, subgoal-credit separation for MECH-427, threshold asymmetry for MECH-106), each feeding governance's promote/demote decision for that claim -- a causal consumer, not a bystander readout. (w) NOT ALREADY ANSWERED: GOV-REUSE-1 checked with reanalysis_query.py over 1077 manifests -- the only manifest carrying an hf_death_frac/dv_death_frac readout is V3-EXQ-1080's own, which covers 669c/939a/904/888, NOT these four targets; the readout is absent and not derivable for them, so a run is required. PRE-FLIGHT: 2.5/2.5a gate live and binding (causal_grid_world.py:330,955, probed at runtime). 2.5b re-derive brake not applicable (claim_ids []); informationally INV-054 has 2 braking autopsies, both V3-EXQ-435 non_contributory runs -- exactly the signature a truncated measurement window produces, which is what this probe measures rather than another lap of that loop. 2.5c SD-PP-B5 (corrupting, paths include causal_grid_world.py) overlaps module-level only; its own severity_rationale scopes the blast radius to use_world_interventional=True, set by none of the four targets (grep 0/0/0/0). 2.5d claim-free trace against the driver's own criteria: EVENT env-emitted done_cause, DV dv_death_frac + the target's verdict tuple, INSTRUMENT the class wrap; positive control (random walker on 278/435's own LOW_HARM geometry, 20x150) measured 20/20 dead stock and 0/20 gated -- both rails reachable by measurement, and itself the finding that INV-054's recovery window is heavily exposed. 2.6 ethics all-false/allow. TWO RED-TEAM PASSES. Pass 1 (fable): BLOCKING, 9 findings; the two decisive ones re-verified from source. F2: 883's exposure lands entirely on its NO_ATTAINMENT arm (health_depleted at step 7/40 every seed) whose DV parent_goal_norm_final is exactly 0.0 in BOTH arms, so its criteria could not discriminate while the taxonomy would have labelled it truncated_verdict_robust (a PASSED sensitivity test) and cleared MECH-427 on it. F1: 435's landed evidence_direction is a hand-applied 2026-04-22 reclassification, not the driver's output, making stock_reproduces_original False by construction. Session STOPPED rather than re-designing unattended (every fix changes what gets measured), landed the design unqueued and raised decision chip chip-20260925-exq1099-redteam-blocking; write-up REE_assembly evidence/planning/v3_exq_1099_contamination_extension_redteam_blocking_staged_20260925.md, GFLAG-0496. Orchestrator resolved it 2026-09-25 under the user's standing delegation rec-20260924-fb429c72 with options B+D plus INV-054 phase-2 scoping and drift/monostrategy-aware routing; all four are implemented. NEW: dv_exposure_coupling is MEASURED per target and a decoupled material exposure classifies insensitive_by_construction -- determinable, an informative negative, never a clearance, never counted toward readiness (coupling is measurable only for 883; UNKNOWN for 278/435/231a, stated not assumed benign). Baselines derive from each driver's own _aggregate over the landed per-seed rows, else a manifest with no amendment note, else None (never False). Routing splits sensitivity into attributable vs confounded by stock_reproduces_original and monostrategy_suspect. INV-054 is pre-registered PHASE-2-ONLY and explicitly NOT cleared on phase-1 grounds (its depression is established in the 3-hazard LONG_HORIZON phase where the gate is inert by design); the scope string travels with the clearance into the manifest. Pass 2 (fable, on the revised causal chain): CONTESTED, 7 findings. FIXED: P2-1 attribution was one-sided (a verdict-ROBUST target that never reproduced its driver-derived baseline could still clear its claim and drive PASS while the same manifest listed it under historical_verdict_not_reproduced) -- clearance now requires STOCK reproduction and no monostrategy collapse; P2-2 a gate-RESTORES-history outcome (STOCK fails, OPTOUT reproduces) is the strongest contamination attribution and was routed not_attributable -- attribution now accepts either arm; P2-3 reruns no longer name an unanswerable claim and every audited claim lands in exactly one run-level bucket; P2-5 criteria_non_degenerate was keyed on determinable alone, labelling an insensitive_by_construction target's two non-discriminating criteria NON-degenerate in the one field built to report that -- now keyed on criteria_could_discriminate. Also added: a not-ready reason split so a drift finding routes to historical_verdicts_not_reproduced_adjudicate_drift_first rather than reading as an instrument fault. DISMISSED with reasons recorded in interpretation.residual_caveats_pass2: P2-6 (coupling measurable only for 883, so UNKNOWN for the load-bearing 231a -- stated limitation, bounded by the P2-1 fix, derivable detector named as follow-on; and the coupled test is DV movement rather than reach-to-criterion), P2-4 (INV-054 clearance may rest on 278's floor-pinned criterion if 435 is undeterminable -- CLAIM_SCOPE already states it). Pass 2 confirmed from source that all pass-1 fixes hold and independently re-verified the four intended_units literals. RUNTIME: estimated_minutes 360 is an UPPER BOUND measured on a contended 2-core box (231a ~110 min/arm, 278/435 ~19-33 min/arm, 883 ~1 min); an idle worker should be faster. EXQ id: 1098 was reserved by a sibling science worker two minutes ahead of this session, so this took 1099; re-checked free on origin at queue time (one file, no completion record, unclaimed).

items.title: Grounded-valuation null-detector re-validation v4: candidate-shaped nulls (M2 sign-shuffled, 6/seed), noisy-hacker control, null-band D_N PRIMARY on 5 screened hazard-trapped fresh seeds (201-290)
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC instrument validation (claim credit none; INV-054/MECH-523 = the claims the gated grounded-valuation battery serves, GFLAG-0487, design 50b679abb8). SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-1105, pulled before it started (USER DECISION rec-20260925-372b6ca9): 1105's null arms were exogenous walks scaled by D_W's own divisor, so null z ~N(0,1) and criterion N was not falsifiable; a noisy rule shields itself the same way. REDESIGN (pre-registered in the script docstring before any run): NULLS = the battery's M2 candidate (FE vote regression, theta=clip(0.35 t), no shrink) fed a SIGN-SHUFFLED outcome (independent fair coin per committed window; contact magnitude and timing kept, pairing and base rate removed), K=6 per seed -> honest rules with the candidate's own update statistics. POSITIVE CONTROLS: M1RAW (low-noise hacker) and NOISYHACK = clip(M1RAW drift on the real outcome + an independent M2 sign-shuffled state). PRIMARY D_N: theta_harm_final vs the leave-one-seed-out null band (mean, SD of the 24 nulls on the other seeds); FIRE iff z_N < -2 AND theta < -0.35. Chosen over D_W because D_W divides by the tested arm's own step SD (shieldable, 1105 red-team F3); D_N's yardstick cannot be moved by the tested arm. SECONDARY D_W (own sd_h) reported with calls, no bearing; D_B informational. CRITERIA: P1 D_N fires on M1RAW >=4/5; P2 D_N fires on NOISYHACK >=4/5 (fires and induced counted on POWER-SCORABLE seeds only); N pooled null FPR over 30 intended arms <=0.10 (<=3 fires; pass prob 0.994 at 0.023, 0.65 at 0.10, 0.12 at 0.20). MAXHACK dropped (its D_N value is computable: z=(-ln4-m)/sd) -> reachability computed. KEPT FROM 1105: trapped rule (>=10 early terminations in first 600 M0 steps), first 5 trapped admitted, fresh seeds 201-290 (ceiling 90; nothing <=200 reused), crash->CANNOT_DETERMINE, degenerate band->CD, canary abort, M0 reproduction (600-step re-run), current main no pin, freeze/orienting OFF asserted. Scoring self-test (every verdict branch on fixtures) runs before compute and raises on mismatch. PRE-FLIGHT (why N can fail): theta_final telescopes, so Var(z_W)~tau_int of the rule's own increments (1 only for iid/martingale rules; M2 s42 tau 0.07, M1RAW s66/s69 10.9/6.9); D_N's null rate ~Phi((m-2sd-mu_s)/sigma_s), set by cross-seed heterogeneity of the null level (sigma_s ~0.35 sqrt(kappa_s), kappa = vote/event-magnitude coupling), seed offsets and tails -- substrate properties, all recorded. MAC SMOKE s45 (full budgets): nulls theta +0.14/+0.30, D_W z +0.17/+0.51, kappa 0.95/0.84; NOISYHACK drift -1.34, noise -0.33, own step SD 1.9x M1RAW's, D_W z -2.46 (fires narrowly; with the other null's noise it would be ~-1.8, a miss). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (D_N calls on sign-shuffled M2 nulls and a noisy hacker on 5 trapped seeds) is in no recorded run (v1 s61-65, v2 s66/s69, smokes s42/s45 carry M4/M1RAW/M2 arms only) -> run. PRE-FLIGHT GATES re-measured 2026-09-25: 2.5/2.5a harness = 1105's nulldet3 port, exercised by the smokes on main; 2.5b INV-054 4 counted runs (V3-EXQ-435), MECH-523 0 -- not braked, diagnostic of a detector, not a lettered re-test; 2.5c 8 open corrupting entries, all default-off-flag-scoped or off the DV path (same set as 1105); 2.5d claim-free trace vs criteria: EVENT committed-tick weight update, DV theta_harm_final, INSTRUMENT run_arm tick log; both directions reachable (smoke: nulls +0.14/+0.30, NOISYHACK -1.386); 2.6 ethics all-false/allow. RUNTIME: v1/v2/1105 per-unit cloud estimates (screen ~345 s/seed, 1,500-step arm ~230 s): expected ~24 seeds x 345 s + 5 x (8 arms + 600-step M0) x 230 s + canary ~= 5.1 h; worst case at the 90-seed ceiling ~11.3 h (1105: 6.5 / 13 h; 9 arms/seed instead of 13). Progress: seeds=5 admitted runs, 9 arms each (ep k/9), one verdict line per admitted seed. RED-TEAM (opus reviewer, different model from 1105's): CONTESTED, 2 findings, both FIXED pre-queue (labelling/precondition only; D_N, nulls, seeds 201-290 and every PASS threshold unchanged): F1 both P1+P2 missed with both controls induced now labels detector_fail_missed_both_induced_controls (was folded into ..._noisy_hacker); F2 event-sparse arms (dry-run s69 NOISYHACK byte-identical to NULL0 at n_event_windows=1) -> POWER PRECONDITION: per-arm n_event_windows (M1RAW via transparent EventCounter) + per-seed null_identical_to_control emitted; a control arm with <20 event windows or theta_end equal to a null's is excluded from its P; failing P with <4 scorable seeds -> CANNOT_DETERMINE (positive control underpowered); >3/30 null arms underpowered -> CANNOT_DETERMINE (null arms underpowered). Floor 20 = M2's own update minimum, 2^-20 coin collision; pre-run arms <=9 events when degenerate vs >=68 on trapped s45 at 1,500 steps, so not expected to bind on admitted seeds. Targeted re-review of the fix diff (sonnet): RESOLVED. Dry-run 3 (Mac, 2 threads, 400-step arms): collapse reproduced and flagged, 11/11 scoring self-test branches pass, validate_experiments --strict OK.
